props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user asks to close the drawer.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge it slides in from: "right" (default), "left" or "bottom".

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the drawer. Also names it for screen readers.

props.name: description
props.description: Short text shown under the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown in the body. It scrolls if it is long.

props.name: footer
props.description: Buttons row pinned to the bottom.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the panel.
